sections.heading: 1. Easy wins
lines: ① Move the wallet to a front pocket.
② Driving or sitting? Get out every 30 min.
③ A few 5–10 minute walks through the day.
④ Most people improve over weeks to months.

sections.heading: 2. Urgent care if…
lines: Groin numbness, bladder or bowel changes,
or worsening leg weakness — GP or ED.

slides.heading: Seek urgent care if you notice

caption:
Moving your wallet out of your back pocket is a reasonable idea. It's just rarely the full answer to sciatica.

Sciatica describes pain travelling down the leg from irritated nerve roots. It can feel intense, but most people improve over weeks to a few months. Current guidelines suggest staying as active as you comfortably can rather than resting in bed: short walks and frequent position changes usually help.

Chiropractic care can be one helpful tool, especially combined with graded exercise and a clear plan. Numbness around the groin, bladder or bowel changes, or worsening leg weakness need urgent medical care.
